Memorial Resigning from the Position of Consultant [Original Note: Eulmi Year]
Former Inspector, your subject Yi Gan, trembling with fear, bows his head repeatedly. I respectfully bow a hundred times and speak to the wise and heroic Majesty. I, your subject, on the fifth day of the second month, received the royal decree appointing me as a Consultant to the Royal Crown Prince's Tutorial Office, ordering me to ride the post horse and come up immediately. Hearing the royal command, I was terrified and did not know what to do. I am originally a scholar from the countryside, having studied for the civil service examinations in my youth, aiming for salary and profit. As I grew older, I became more desolate and failed to pass the examination. With my parents old and my family poor, my feet have not rested from the examination halls, so I am not a scholar who values himself in the mountains and forests. Occasionally, because of my inherent nature, I have had some interest in the dregs of books, and I have been talked about by scholar friends, with empty fame spreading far. This led to me being mistakenly recommended in recent years and receiving a royal appointment. This is far from my true situation. At that time, being a person of low status and position, constrained by legal regulations, I did not dare to submit a memorial to clarify the truth, but I have felt ashamed and fearful in my heart. I did not expect that this time, I would again receive such grace beyond my wildest dreams. The position is noble and important, unlike ordinary appointments, so I am truly overwhelmed and cannot settle my feelings. I have heard that the establishment of this office is not ancient. It was created during the reign of the Holy Ancestor in the days of appointing the virtuous without bias, to wait for extraordinary scholars. Therefore, those who have received this royal command before were all of the flow of mountain and forest virtue and learning. What they carried was truly enough to weigh the royal court. However, in recent years, learning has decayed and the Way has been lost. Scholars are not as good as their predecessors, and yet they must be those who have retired from the fame and profit, dedicated themselves to reading, and have some reputation and reality to match the name. Because the royal health was not well, all memorials were temporarily suspended, so after arriving at the office, it was not immediately submitted. Subsequently, Confucian scholars argued for impeachment, and friends in the capital, fearing public opinion, privately pushed for my return, waiting for the public opinion to settle. I have been silent and waiting for more than two months. The position is empty and delayed, and I have not received any instructions. My situation can be said to be desperate. If it is said that the period of dismissal must wait for me to explain myself and leave the field, then I cannot remain silent any longer. I dare to change the paper and the previous draft, and continue to appeal. I am even more terrified. I think that the memorial of the Confucian scholars is truly out of public opinion at the time. That I am not fit for this position is not only known to me, but the whole world knows it. That I cannot occupy it for even a day is even more clear. I beg your Majesty to quickly remove me to apologize to the people's words. I would be very fortunate. I, a lowly subject, have disturbed your quiet rest with my private request. My crime deserves ten thousand deaths. I respectfully report this at the risk of death.

번역

Memorial Resigning from the Position of Consultant [Second Memorial]
I, your subject, am a lowly scholar from a poor village, extremely foolish and ignorant. My conduct is not sincere, and I have stolen an empty reputation, deceiving the age. I was suddenly promoted to a position near the court. That my name and reality do not match is something that gods and ghosts witness. After the royal summons, I did not dare not to explain myself, and I exhausted my sincere feelings, disturbing your Majesty. I know very well that I have committed a crime and have nowhere to escape. Day and night, I have been trembling, respectfully waiting for your Majesty's decision. Ten days ago, I received the provincial governor's reply, which not only did not approve my resignation but ordered me to come up quickly. I was even more terrified and did not know what to do. It is because my writing is clumsy and my reasoning is inconsistent, so my private feelings could not be conveyed, and my detailed explanation was nothing more than a return to courtesy. It brought shame to my teachers and friends. Those true scholars who hide in the caves and do not sell themselves will surely distance themselves, and they may not necessarily take me as a warning. The shame and disgrace are almost worse than being whipped in the market. If I go forward and accept it, the lack of foundation and the confusion of the straight and the crooked are not worth discussing. If I do not care about people's words, my name and integrity will be lost. What the former scholars called "bringing trouble to the clear court above and heavy shame to the scholar forest below" is also nothing more than this. This is what I am most afraid of. I have been humiliated by the royal summons, wandering and hesitant for a year. If I measure my share and weigh the meaning, the confusion and fear are as such. If I reveal my heart, the royal command cannot be turned back. My situation is very miserable. If I delay and hesitate, my crimes will accumulate. I hope your Majesty will pity me, quickly remove me from my position, and punish me. So that the path of using the virtuous will not be occupied by those who are false and opportunistic, and those who run away from the royal command will not be lucky enough to escape. This is not the luck of a foolish subject, but the way for the royal court to govern and serve the people. I cannot express my extreme anxiety and prayer. I have already received the royal approval, so I should have appealed again, but I am afraid of disturbing you. I have been silent for a long time and did not dare. But I think that the name and the vessel are very important, and it is not right to occupy them empty for a long time. I have to risk my life to appeal. In the process of delay, my crime has grown. I am terrified and trembling. I respectfully report this at the risk of death.
